steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Muslims believe that physical death is not the end — there is an afterlife (akhirah). After death, the soul is questioned in the grave by Munkar and Nakir, and on the Day of Judgement (Yawm al-Din), all people will be resurrected and judged by Allah. | Exam Tip: Belief in akhirah is one of the Six Articles of Faith. Without it, the whole Islamic moral framework would collapse — there would be no ultimate justice and no reason to follow Allah's commands if this life is all there is. | RS Exam Tips — Akhirah: Life After Death: 1. For Akhirah: Life After Death questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3.
